correctness.rationale: For positive P_i,D_i, w>1 and additive water-equivalent volumes, Minkowski gives F_w(sum P_i,sum D_i)<=sum F_w(P_i,D_i)<P+D. Equality on the left iff all positive local pairs are proportional; derivative d log F_theta/dtheta=-H(p_theta)/theta^2 gives unique fitted theta in (1,w]. For P_i=P(a_i+eps u_i), D_i=D(a_i+eps v_i), sum u=sum v=0 and positive a_i, the degree-one-homogeneous Hessian of F_w, including its a_i^{-1} scaling, yields (w^2(w-1)/2)*[p(1-p)/H(p)]*sum (u_i-v_i)^2/a_i *eps^2+O(eps^3) for w-w_hat. The entropy identity H((1+z)/2)>=(1-z^2) log2 is exact and is strict for 0<|z|<1, giving sharp envelope w^2(w-1)*A/(8 log2) uniquely at P=D for nonzero A. P-gradient ordering proves global two-region monotonicity for every 0<a,b<1. At A=0 proportionality holds for all sufficiently small eps. Independent scalar root solving and the exact radical test were replayed. Finite samples support but do not establish quantifiers.
